notes: Rule 425 / Rule 14a-12 press release (May 26, 2021) announcing board approval of a proposed reorganization combining NXQ and NXR into NXP. The acquirer is identified by ticker (NXP) in the operative sentence; names are matched to tickers from the same press release. Exchange basis, closing timing, outside date, meeting and record dates are not stated (proxy materials 'expected to be filed in the coming weeks'). Conditions: only shareholder approval is named; other conditions are mentioned generically ('subject to certain conditions'). security_class 'common' is based on the reference to trading volume for common shares; the reorganization combines whole funds.
